title: Migrate sessions from cookies to JWT
description: Move session handling from server-side cookies to short-lived JWTs so the mobile app can share auth.

comments.author: Mia Torres
comments.body: Chose JWT with 15 min expiry plus refresh tokens. We rejected long-lived JWTs since they cannot be revoked.

comments.author: Mia Torres
comments.body: Gotcha: clock skew between services broke validation, added 30s leeway.
